description: Table 2 is a three-column reference table rendered as an image, headed "Feature name", "Abbreviation" and "Calculation formula". It catalogues the input material descriptors feeding the machine-learning model and is divided by three section rows: "Weighting parameters" (13 entries), "Thermodynamic parameters" (3 entries) and "Mismatch parameters" (25 entries), 41 feature rows in total. The weighting group lists VEC (formula k = Σ_{i=1}^{n} c_i*k_i), Tm, e/a, G, E, Ec, w, r, χ (Pauling electronegativity), B, υ (Poisson's ratio), E_{I-1st} and E_{I-2nd}; all except VEC have blank formula cells. The thermodynamic group prints ΔSmix = −8.314 Σ_{i=1}^{n} c_i*ln(c_i), ΔHmix = 4 Σ_{i=1,j>i}^{n} c_i c_j H_{i-j}^{mix} and Gmix = Hmix − Tm*Smix. The mismatch group prints a shared strengthening-model mismatch formula η_k (rowspan for η_G and η_B), the shared difference formula δk = √(Σ_{i=1}^{n} c_i*(1 − k_i/k)^2) for ten δ-quantities (δG, δB, δυ, δr, δTm, δVEC, δe/a, δEc, δEI-1st, δEI-2nd), the γ parameter with r_min and r_max, Δχ = √(Σ c_i*(χ − χ_i)^2), and the shared local-mismatch formula D_k for eleven D-quantities (D_G, D_B, D_r, D_υ, D_χ, D_Tm, D_VEC, D_e/a, D_Ec, D_EI-1st, D_EI-2nd). No numeric values, units or sample names are tabulated; the table defines how composition is converted into 41 model inputs.

observations.observation: The image is an image-rendered three-column table whose column headers are 'Feature name', 'Abbreviation' and 'Calculation formula'.

The feature rows are divided by three unnumbered section rows spanning the table: 'Weighting parameters', 'Thermodynamic parameters' and 'Mismatch parameters'; these section rows have empty abbreviation and formula cells.

Only the first weighting-parameter entry carries a formula, printed as k = Σ_{i=1}^{n} c_i*k_i for 'Valence electron concentration' (VEC); the other twelve weighting entries (Tm, e/a, G, E, Ec, w, r, χ, B, υ, E_{I-1st}, E_{I-2nd) have blank formula cells.
The thermodynamic parameters print three formulas: ΔSmix = −8.314 Σ_{i=1}^{n} c_i*ln(c_i), ΔHmix = 4 Σ_{i=1,j>i}^{n} c_i c_j H_{i-j}^{mix} (Hmix), and Gmix = Hmix − Tm*Smix.
The constant 8.314 appears explicitly in the printed mixing-entropy formula.

The rows 'Shear module mismatch in strengthening model' (η_G) and 'Bulk module mismatch in strengthening model' (η_B) share one rowspan formula cell labelled η_k, written as a multi-level stacked fraction.
Ten 'Difference in ...' quantities (δG, δB, δυ, δr, δTm, δVEC, δe/a, δEc, δEI-1st, δEI-2nd) share a single rowspan formula printed as δk = √(Σ_{i=1}^{n} c_i*(1 − k_i/k)^2).
A separate 'γ parameter' row prints γ as a ratio of two expressions containing the inner-radius terms r_min and r_max and the atomic radius r.
'Difference in electronegativity' (Δχ) is printed as Δχ = √(Σ_{i=1}^{n} c_i*(χ − χ_i)^2).

The eleven 'Local ... mismatch' rows (D_G, D_B, D_r, D_υ, D_χ, D_Tm, D_VEC, D_e/a, D_Ec, D_EI-1st, D_EI-2nd) share one rowspan formula printed as D_k = Σ_{i=1}^{n} Σ_{j=1,i≠1}^{n} c_j c_j |k_i − k_j|, with the repeated 'c_j c_j' and 'i≠1' subscripts as rendered in the image.

Counting the feature rows printed in the table gives 13 weighting + 3 thermodynamic + 25 mismatch = 41 feature rows, matching the 41 features referred to in the citing text; this count is not printed in the table itself.
The caption states the table is a 'List of input material features'.

The citing text states that 41 features were collected and standardized to ensure equal contribution of each feature and to eliminate scale-difference bias, and that their calculation formulas are shown in Table 2.
No numeric feature values, units, sample names or compositions appear anywhere in the table; it contains feature names, abbreviations and formulas only.

subfigures.description: Single image-rendered table with columns 'Feature name', 'Abbreviation', 'Calculation formula'. Three section header rows ('Weighting parameters', 'Thermodynamic parameters', 'Mismatch parameters') organise 41 feature rows; only VEC, the three thermodynamic parameters, and the mismatch/size/γ/electronegativity/local-mismatch quantities carry printed formulas, the remainder having empty formula cells.

unreadable_items: The exact typographic structure of the η_k stacked-fraction formula (rowspan cell shared by η_G and η_B) cannot be resolved unambiguously from the rendering; the caption's linear form differs in grouping from the printed layout
Poisson's ratio symbol is rendered ambiguously (printed as 'υ'; the caption/HTML uses \nu)
Subscripts in the shared D_k local-mismatch formula read 'c_j c_j' and 'i≠1' as printed, which appears to be a typographical artefact rather than the intended c_i c_j / i≠j
